content: It appears the notation for CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact ?m.5 is not sufficiently scoped and clashes with notation for docs#Sum ⊕\oplus⊕. This makes Sum types impossible to use with notation if one opens Cslib with import Cslib
A PR scoping this would be welcome, it was just accidentally missed I assume. (Though perhaps in general it's questionable to overlap with core notation at all)

Shreyas Srinivas said:

opens Cslib with import Cslib

Do you mean "opens cslib" as open Cslib?

Chris Henson said:

Though perhaps in general it's questionable to overlap with core notation at all

having worked with the notation for propositional connectives (which i swapped to be be same as the operations on Prop in review) i'm inclined to agree

Thomas Waring said:

Chris Henson said:

having worked with the notation for propositional connectives (which i swapped to be be same as the operations on Prop in review) i'm inclined to agree

Doesn't the trick suggested (and implemented) for modal logic notation in cslib#528 address this? We could do the same here (it should also be scoped, and a pr with just the scoping would be welcome).
sorry i must have missed something — isn't the notation for Proposition.and etc the same?
